name: scout-panel
notes: Scouts → synthesize → cross-family judge panel → a person (T4). Every claim is checked against its source by three judges on different platforms; any refuted claim sends the brief to be fixed.

nodes.task:
{goal}

Check each claim in {prev_artifacts} against its source. Mark it supported, refuted or unverified. Claim `win` if no claim is refuted, `fail` listing the refuted ones, `abstain` if you could not open the sources.

Remove or fix the refuted claims and label the unverified ones. The panel said:
